description: The Global Configuration keys the channel role reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5). Durations are integers in milliseconds.

hitl_response_window.description: How long a channel waits for a human answer before declaring a hitl_contact_* round expired, in milliseconds (architecture §3.5.2).

preconditions.message: auction_timeout has to be less than hitl_response_window (architecture §3.5.2)

result_delivery.description: How the channel that opened a trace delivers its outcome: one value per audience and a default one (architecture §3.5.4).

default.description: The value of an audience audiences does not name.

audiences.description: The value of each audience that does not take the default.
